subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: The Indian law enacted in 2012 that specifically defines and criminalises sexual offences against children, mandates child-friendly reporting and trial procedures, and requires teachers/school staff to report suspected abuse, is the:

options.option_text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015

explanation: The POCSO Act (2012) specifically addresses child sexual abuse, with mandatory reporting duties extending to teachers and school staff — distinct from the Juvenile Justice Act (which deals with children in conflict with the law and children needing care/protection more broadly).

subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: The 2015 Indian law that governs the care, protection, and rehabilitation of children in conflict with the law (juvenile offenders) as well as children in need of care and protection, is the:

options.option_text: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015

explanation: The Juvenile Justice Act (2015) provides a legal framework for handling juveniles in conflict with the law and children needing care/protection — distinct from POCSO (specifically sexual offences against children) or the RTE Act (right to elementary education).
